item: Large-import memory refusal asked before validation and copy; keyword step loses its separate duplicate-count pass
summary: R319 release note: importing a backup into an encrypted corpus now checks the memory the merge needs, with the backup's own row counts, as soon as the backup is unpacked, before the staged file is validated and the corpus copied; two field instances (Qubes VMs of about 3 GB) had seven imports refused only after 48 min to 9 h each. The keyword merge step no longer runs a separate pass over every incoming keyword just to count duplicates (7,588 s and 11,555 s on the two field imports); the count is read off the id map the step already builds and is unchanged.
